stem.en: A cyclist starts 1 m from a lamp post and rides away from it at a constant 2 m/s. Plot the cyclist's distance from the lamp post (in metres) for at least three different times between t = 0 s and t = 3 s.

explanation.en: Constant speed means distance grows by the same amount every second - distance = starting distance + speed × time, so distance = 1 + 2t. At t = 0, 1, 2, 3 s the cyclist is 1, 3, 5, 7 m away: every point you plot should sit on that straight line.

hints.en: Distance = starting distance + (speed × time). Work out the distance at t = 0 s first - that's where the line starts.
